Both of them like dumplings and coffee. Grace thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Grace likes cloudy days best. He came in dripping wet from the heavy rain.

Grace learned a lot about English. It takes twenty minutes to get to the work station by bike. Grace borrowed a book about English from the museum. Best of all, after twenty years abroad, he returned to his homeland.
Grace hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Life is full of small surprises. Grace wrote about the day in the diary. My legs are sore after running five kilometers yesterday.
Grace is going to travel to Chengdu in September. They took many photos at the front desk. The weather was cloudy that day.
